translation_notes: the region constructs no RDF term and no triple - it parses a TriG file whose path comes from the test suite - so translated.ldpy is the original with only an explanatory comment added; no island appears
no @prefix declared: the DC/RDF/DCTERMS/PROV/XSD namespaces imported by the enclosing test module are unused in the region (the draft declared all five)

context shim: nanopub_testsuite_connector.py is an offline stand-in for the nanopub-testsuite-connector package, whose NanopubTestSuite.get_latest() downloads the test suite from GitHub at import time; models (TestSuiteSubfolder, TestSuiteEntry, SigningKeyPair) are verbatim and the indexing follows connector.py. Identical for both sides
vendored data: testsuite/valid/plain/Darwin-Core-schema-resource.trig, the file the real get_valid(PLAIN)[0] returns (it sorts first), from nanopub-testsuite (MIT, see testsuite/LICENSE)

demo harness added identically to both sides: the region returns a Dataset, which the harness cannot compare (rdflib.compare ingests triples, a Dataset yields quads), so both files end by calling the region and flattening the result into a module-level Graph `demo_union` that module-state comparison can check
